recent.text: The Nuggets played really hard and defended really well, which makes a 110-100 loss in Houston sting that much more. Jamal Murray played 39:12, Nikola Jokic 38:38.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Eight-second violation on Aaron Gordon bringing the ball up. Costly. Houston scores at the other end to push lead to 10 and Denver is running out of time despite an impressive effort.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Offensively, this has been a Jamal Murray carry job from beginning to end. Nobody else can get it going for the Nuggets, who trail 93-87 with 6:27 left.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Brutal. Christian Braun has an excellent defensive possession out of the timeout to force a turnover, pushes the pace, hits an open Murray in the corner... and the one Nugget who *has* been knocking down shots tonight misses one.
recent.author: Bennett Durando
recent.quoted_text: You could see Cam Johnson willing that shot to go in after it left his hands. On a night the Nuggets haven't been able to hit anything, they finally knock down two straight 3s (Jokic and Johnson) to get within 10 and force a Houston timeout.

recent.text: Nuggets managed to not get run out of the gym by halftime after it looked like they were going to early in the second quarter. Jamal Murray has 15 points on 5/9 FG, and the rest of the team has 25 combined on 10/35 shooting. It's 54-40, Rockets, who've led by as many as 19.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Rockets on an extended 15-2 run since late in the first quarter. DeMar DeRozan 0/3 from the field, and Nuggets' second unit struggling to create any sort of advantage other than his isos. Jamal Murray and Christian Braun into the game for Spencer Jones and Tyus Jones out of a TO.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Houston has gotten the ball up the floor fast off Denver’s missed shots. Has led to a few open looks. Nuggets down 32-24 after a Jokic + bench lineup goes -4 in the last 3:16 of the first quarter.

recent.text: That was a fun show. The Pacers threw their best punch in the second half and Denver survived it for a 114-102 win in Mexico City. Nuggets had seven scorers in double figures, none with 20. Big-time performances in the second unit from Cam Johnson, DeMar DeRozan, Spencer Jones.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Nuggets are trying to survive a comeback push from Indiana. DeMar DeRozan has been massive as a scorer and playmaker. Knocked down a middy a couple possessions ago, then draws a crowd and hits Cam Johnson for an open 3. Johnson has 18 points (8/10 FG), DeRozan 11 and 5 assists.
